description: Map the shrunk latent to 0-99 by quantile-normalizing the format-and-skill population to a target normal: rating = clip(round(mean + sd * Phi^-1(p)), 0, 99), where p is the Hazen plotting position (rank-0.5)/N of the latent within the population. Populations are per (format, skill) and pooled across ALL tournaments so ratings are cross-era comparable (not per-tournament forced to 99).
